decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a low-cost complement to the core flooring offer. It meets the modest aspirations set for accessories, and a hiring firm in a growing industry has the slack to carry it.
The maintenance oil line supports the firm's oiled-floor systems and its customer relationships. It ties up few resources, so there is little reason to start a search for alternatives.
This care line for oiled floors fits the firm's surface-treatment offer, and its results are likely satisfactory relative to what the firm expects from accessories.
A moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory that installers need with the firm's floors. It is likely to meet aspirations and needs little extra effort to keep.
The high-density foam underlay rounds out the accessory range. Some risk of overlap with the other underlay remains, but slack allows the firm to keep it.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's established business. It builds on deep production know-how and is very likely to meet performance aspirations.
